name: AbandonedRuins-paranoidal
title: Abandoned Ruins - Paranoidal
author: FactorioParanoidal
description: Paranoidal ruin set for 'Abandoned Ruins - Updated': 170 new ruins (small, medium, large) with Bob's, Angels and Bio Industries content, defect-quality junk and clean starter kits, dangerous outposts, plus all 'base' ruins with their rails rebuilt for 2.0. Default ruin set. Ruins do not repeat until every ruin of a size has appeared once and, by default, do not depend on the distance from the map center. Discovery journal with map markers and the /ruins command.
